summary: Push Notifications and Signal Analytics testing complete. All 27 backend tests passed. Push notification system works with subscribe/unsubscribe, preferences management (copy trading focused), VAPID key endpoint, test notifications, and history. Signal Analytics provides performance summary, confidence analysis, strategy comparison, and optimal settings recommendations. AI Trader strategy thresholds improved (0.45 min confidence vs 0.35 before).

push_notifications.GET /api/push-notifications/vapid-public: WORKING - Returns configured=false with message (VAPID keys not set in env)
push_notifications.POST /api/push-notifications/subscribe: WORKING - Creates/updates subscription with endpoint, keys, device_name, platform
push_notifications.POST /api/push-notifications/unsubscribe: WORKING - Removes specific endpoint or all subscriptions
push_notifications.GET /api/push-notifications/preferences/: WORKING - Returns copy trading notification preferences
push_notifications.POST /api/push-notifications/send-test/{: WORKING - Sends test notification (MOCKED - stored in DB)
push_notifications.GET /api/push-notifications/history/{wal: WORKING - Returns notification history with limit

signal_analytics.GET /api/signal-analytics/performance-su: WORKING - Returns strategy performance metrics by period
signal_analytics.GET /api/signal-analytics/confidence-ana: WORKING - Returns confidence distribution with recommended threshold
signal_analytics.GET /api/signal-analytics/strategy-compa: WORKING - Compares momentum, mean_reversion, breakout strategies
signal_analytics.GET /api/signal-analytics/optimal-settin: WORKING - Returns recommendations for min_confidence, auto_trade settings
signal_analytics.POST /api/signal-analytics/track-outcome: WORKING - Tracks signal outcome at 1h/4h/24h intervals

ai_trader_improvements.analysis_insight: 74.5% of signals were in low confidence bucket (0.40-0.45) with only 3% approval rate, validating threshold increase
